response.overview: The story revolves around the intricate dynamics and emotional turmoils within a traditional joint family. The narrative primarily focuses on a strict, dominating, and harsh mother-in-law (played by Rina Khan) whose cruel behavior and rigid rules create constant friction, misunderstandings, and sufferings for the family members, especially the daughters-in-law (portrayed by Moushumi and Erin Zaman).  Ferdous plays a pivotal role as a loving and supportive family member trying to maintain peace and harmony amidst the chaos. As egos clash and conspiracies unfold, the household experiences extreme emotional highs and lows. Ultimately, through profound heartbreaks, sacrifices, and realizations, the tyrannical attitude of the mother-in-law is challenged, leading to a touching transformation, repentance, and the eventual reunion of the fractured family
response.title: Dojjal Shasuri ( দজ্জাল শ্বাশুড়ি)
